This [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] '''individual''' was a member of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Jedi Civil War]]. He wielded a [[Color/Legends|green]]-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|combat]].

==History==
[[File:Bastilasstriketeamfacesrevan.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and his comrades confront Darth Revan on the bridge of his flagship.]]
During the [[Jedi Civil War]] this [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] was a member of the [[Jedi strike team (Capture of Darth Revan)|strike team]] sent to [[Capture of Darth Revan|capture]] [[Revan/Legends|Darth Revan]], alongside [[Bastila Shan]] and five others. The Jedi successfully boarded Revan's [[Darth Revan's flagship|flagship]] and fought their way to the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] to confront the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]]. He and three of his comrades were [[Death/Legends|killed]] when Revan's opportunistic [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] [[Darth Malak|Malak]] ordered his gunners to fire upon the bridge, seeking to rid himself of both his [[Sith Master/Legends|master]] and the Jedi.<ref name="KotOR" />
